allOf.description:
Region the contract belongs to. Defaults to Taiwan; populated by
contracts v2 wire payloads (`api/v1/data/contracts_base`). v1 wire
payloads do not carry `region` and decode to `Region::TW` via
`#[serde(default)]`.

shioaji.api.api_v1.constant.Currency.description:
Currency codes mirroring original shioaji `Currency` enum
(`/shioaji/src/shioaji/constant.py:111-131`) and sw relay's
`services/relay/rust/src/schema/constant.rs:215-237`.

event_id.description: Opaque receipt identity; historical query records without an ID use an empty string.

allOf.description: Account used for the order (set after place_order for use in update/cancel)

ca.description: CA signature (set after place_order for use in update/cancel)

daytrade_short.description:
Daytrade-short flag. The sw relay does not echo this back in
`update_status` / `place_order` responses, so it's `None` for every
server-sourced Trade. Kept as `Option<bool>` to stay faithful to the
wire format rather than fabricating a default the server never sent.

allOf.description:
Futures open/close type. Populated by the server for futures trades
(converted from the `ST_OPEN` column in `FORDER_STATUS`), absent for
stock. Mirrors canonical shioaji's `FuturesOrder.octype`.

Stock order condition. Populated by the server for stock trades,
absent for futures/options. Mirrors canonical shioaji's `StockOrder.order_cond`.

Stock order lot. Populated by the server for stock trades,
absent for futures/options. Mirrors canonical shioaji's `StockOrder.order_lot`.

shioaji.api.api_v1.order.types.OrderStat.description: Represents which type of order event was received via P2P.

shioaji.api.api_v1.portf.position_detail.description:
Untagged enum — variant order matters for serde deserialization.
Stock is tried first; its required field `ex_dividends` (no default)
ensures Future JSON won't match.

shioaji.api.api_v1.portf.positions.Posit.description:
Untagged enum — variant order matters for serde deserialization.
Stock is tried first; its required fields (e.g. `yd_quantity`)
ensure Future JSON won't match. Do NOT add #[serde(default)] to those fields.

shioaji.api.api_v1.portf.profit_loss.Pro.description:
Untagged enum — variant order matters for serde deserialization.
Stock is tried first; its required fields (e.g. `dseq`)
ensure Future JSON won't match. Do NOT add #[serde(default)] to those fields.

fee.description: f64 (not i32 like stock) because futures can have fractional fees

tax.description: f64 (not i32 like stock) because futures can have fractional tax

shioaji.api.api_v1.portf.profit_loss_det.description:
Untagged enum — variant order matters for serde deserialization.
Stock is tried first; its required fields (e.g. `cost`)
ensure Future JSON won't match.

shioaji.api.api_v1.portf.profit_loss_sum.description:
Untagged enum — variant order matters for serde deserialization.
Stock is tried first; its required fields (e.g. `entry_cost`)
ensure Future JSON won't match.

Flattened public HTTP contract info. The internally tagged representation
makes `security_type` the OpenAPI discriminator without exposing core
`base`/`info` composition.

Omitted values preserve the historical HTTP behavior (`true`).

Regular subscriptions retain their original flat JSON shape. Combo
subscriptions use `{ "contract": { "legs": [...] }, ... }`.

account_type.description: Account type: "S" for stock, "F" for futures

allOf.description: Security type (STK, FUT, OPT, IND, WRT)

shioaji.server.http.types.ErrorResponse.description:
Error response — returned as JSON for all error status codes.
When the backend returns a JSON-encoded validation error as the detail string,
it is parsed and embedded as a proper JSON object in `details`,
with the human-readable `msg` field extracted into `message`.

details.description: Structured error details (parsed from backend JSON when available)

shioaji.server.http.types.MarketDataCont.description:
A market-data contract can be a regular contract or a structured two-leg combo.

Combo callers provide the original legs. The native slash code used by Solace
and SW is deliberately generated inside Shioaji and is not part of the public API.

400.description: The request could not be understood by the server due to malformed syntax.

403.description: The server refused to authorize the request.

404.description: The requested resource could not be found.

405.description: The request method is not supported for the requested resource.

406.description: The requested resource is capable of generating only content not acceptable according to the Accept headers sent in the request.

407.description: Authentication with the proxy is required.

408.description: The server timed out waiting for the request.

409.description: The request could not be processed because of a conflict in the request.

410.description: The resource requested is no longer available and will not be available again.

411.description: The request did not specify the length of its content, which is required by the requested resource.

412.description: The server does not meet one of the preconditions specified in the request.

413.description: The request is larger than the server is willing or able to process.

414.description: The URI provided was too long for the server to process.

415.description: The request entity has a media type which the server or resource does not support.

417.description: The server cannot meet the requirements of the expect request-header field.

418.description: I was requested to brew coffee, and I am a teapot.

421.description: The server cannot produce a response for this request.

422.description: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

423.description: The source or destination resource of a method is locked.

424.description: The method could not be performed on the resource because the requested action depended on another action and that action failed.

426.description: Switching to the protocol in the Upgrade header field is required.

428.description: The server requires the request to be conditional.

429.description: Too many requests have been received recently.

431.description: The server is unwilling to process the request because either an individual header field, or all the header fields collectively, are too large.

451.description: The requested resource is unavailable due to a legal demand to deny access to this resource.

500.description: The server encountered an internal error while processing this request.

501.description: The server either does not recognize the request method, or it lacks the ability to fulfill the request.

502.description: Received an invalid response from an inbound server it accessed while attempting to fulfill the request.

504.description: The server did not receive a timely response from an upstream server.

505.description: The server does not support, or refuses to support, the major version of HTTP that was used in the request message.

506.description: The server has an internal configuration error.

507.description: The method could not be performed on the resource because the server is unable to store the representation needed to successfully complete the request.

508.description: the server terminated an operation because it encountered an infinite loop while processing a request with "Depth: infinity".

510.description: Further extensions to the request are required for the server to fulfill it.

511.description: the client needs to authenticate to gain network access.
